SUPERPOWER SPECTRUM VOTE (12 minutes — the most interactive slide in Module 2)
SETUP: Explain the spectrum clearly before starting: SAY: "On my left is 'AI will REPLACE this job.' On my right is 'AI will HELP with this job.' In the middle is 'Not sure.' For each job I read out — stand up if you think AI replaces it, stay seated if AI helps it. If you're unsure, raise one hand."
GO THROUGH EACH JOB. After each vote, reveal the thinking: - DOCTOR: Usually split. SAY: "AI can read scans and diagnose diseases. But can it hold a patient's hand? Feel their pain? The AI diagnoses. The doctor heals." - CRICKETER: Most say "Help." SAY: "AI already tracks ball speed, bounce prediction, player fatigue. But Virat Kohli's cover drive? That's still human." - TEACHER: Split. This is the juicy one. Let the debate run for 30 seconds. - DRIVER: Most say "Replace." SAY: "Actually... this is one job where AI is genuinely taking over. Self-driving trucks are already on some Indian highways." - POET: Most say "Help." SAY: "Is a poem written by AI... still a poem? This question has no right answer. But it's worth asking."
FINAL LINE — deliver it like a mic drop: SAY (slowly): "AI doesn't replace people." (pause) "It replaces people who don't know how to use AI." (longer pause) "That's why you're here today."
This line always lands hard. Let the silence run for 3 seconds after you say it.
